claim: You name a program 'transformation,' but the way that the feds designed it is almost directing us to AI.

sources.story_title: Asserter: Rep. Genevieve Mina (D-Anchorage, RHTP advisory council) 'almost directing us to AI' quote; also carries the counter-evidence that Alaska's 400-plus advancing RHTP proposals are majority non-AI (Tanana Chiefs Conference drone vaccine delivery, Ryan Air medical-supply aircraft, wearable monitors, Wrangell School District VR headsets, behavioral telehealth apps)

Counter-evidence: only 6.6% of speed tests at 42 evaluated Alaska healthcare facilities met the 100/20 Mbps telehealth benchmark; more than 63% of Alaska consumer speed tests fell below the 25/3 Mbps threshold
